title: Trace: which function runs first?

questions.prompt: square multiplies a number by itself and inc adds one. What is compose(square, inc)(6)?

choices.why: That squares first and then adds one, which is inc(square(6)): the order is reversed.
That stops after the inner function. Its result still has to go through square.
inc runs first and gives 7; square then gives 49.

checklist.step: Return a function; call g, then f, only when it runs
Show each stage with its real input and output

hints: In f(g(x)) the function written last is the one called first.
Look at what runs while compose itself is running: it should only define a function and return it.
Inside the returned function: call g on x and keep the result, show that stage, call f on the kept result, show that stage, return it.
